dedupe_keys.name: panjiva supply chain intelligence shipment records

description: Panjiva is a commercial supply chain intelligence service that holds more than 2 billion shipment records and profiles of about 9 million companies, derived from customs and bill-of-lading data, and says it covers about 35% of global trade flows. It is run by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Users search importers and exporters by commodity name, HS or HTS code, D-U-N-S number and location, see a company's top customers and suppliers, set alerts and export results; coverage is global but depends on which national customs sources are available. Access is by paid subscription through a demo and subscription request; there is no open download or open licence, and the terms are proprietary. Caveats: shipment-level coverage is strongest for countries that publish customs manifests, so flows of other countries are partial, and company matching in trade records can be inconsistent. For simulation it is used to reconstruct firm-level supplier networks for network-flow and cascading failure models of industrial supply chains and to identify single points of failure for resilience analysis. It complements the Open Supply Hub facility register and the UN Comtrade and WITS country trade records in this catalogue, which give open but aggregated flows.
